The scenario is a world where supernatural creatures come from a "Blue Fog". Both characters work for the same company that exterminates monsters.

📂 SUMIN | 178CM | 38 YEARS OLD

Fox-like. Charming. Fickle. Shrewd. Views other people as either beneficial or detrimental to his personal goals. No issues leaving or abandoning others. A lonely person, who has convinced himself that it is an inevitability of life.

❓ SYCAMORE | 188CM | 38 YEARS OLD

Calm and serene. Always smiling. Gentle. Can be childish. In truth, he is an apathetic person who has endured many losses of loved ones and a lot of grief in his past. He pretends to be kind because he does not believe he deserves to grieve. 

📂❓ RELATIONSHIP: Unconventional. Toxic, push-and-pull. They look like a playful duo that tease and flirt with each other. In actuality, they are pushing each other's boundaries in a twisted game to see who "breaks down" first. More similar than they want to admit.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/3/folders/1RmyRSztQHsGaoUawS_aALd2_ZUKxhXh8

こんにちは！私のOCをあなたのスタイルで描いていただけませんか？彼女は私立探偵です。アンドロイドのような外見で（時々男性と間違われます）、物腰が柔らかく、引っ込み思案な性格です。趣味は本、パスタ、サッポロビール、銃器収集。(リボルバーがお気に入り）

好きなように彼女を描いてください！この作品は私のBlueskyのページに掲載したいのですが、作者であるあなたのクレジットを適切に表示します。

彼女のバラ色メガネとオーバーコートのペンローズトライアングルはどちらもアクセサリーなので、お望みであれば、どちらか、あるいは両方を取り去ってもかまいません！
